sloka: दृष्टास्माभिः प्ररुदिता दृढं शोकपरायणा ।अनर्हा दुःखशोकाभ्यामेकां दीनां ह्यनाथवत् ।। ७.४९.५ ॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭāsmābhiḥ praruditā dṛḍhaṁ śokaparāyaṇā ।anarhā duḥkhaśokābhyāmekāṁ dīnāṁ hyanāthavat ।। 7.49.5 ॥

translations.english: We have seen her weeping profusely, intensely overcome by grief, alone and miserable like an orphan, though she is undeserving of such sorrow and grief.
